description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android activity named QiblaActivity that manages the UI and sensor interactions for a Qibla compass feature in the app. It handles lifecycle events, updates the compass orientation based on sensor data, and provides calibration hints to the user.

classes.name: QiblaActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a Qibla compass, manages sensor updates, and provides calibration instructions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up sensors, preferences, and UI components.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes sensor listening and updates the bearing based on user-selected city.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops sensor updates to conserve resources.

methods.name: updateQiblaBearingFromSelectedCity
methods.description: Calculates and sets the bearing to the Qibla (Kaaba) based on stored city coordinates.

methods.name: renderCalibrationHint
methods.description: Displays calibration or interference hints based on sensor accuracy and environment.
